independent_calculations: Polar area scaling gives det DF=L_theta=G/c(r)>0. Where G=|Psi_z|^2, |Psi_z|^-2 F_theta/r=i exp(iL)/c(r).
Put Q=a b_theta-b a_theta. Cauchy-Riemann gives (a^2+b^2)_r=2Q/r. Differentiating G_r=g'(a^2+b^2-1)+2gQ/r gives coefficient 4g'/r-2g/r^2, agreeing with actual p20 image.
If 0<delta<d, phi(d)delta/d=delta max(-log d,1)<=phi(delta); if d<=delta, phi(d)<=phi(delta) by monotonicity. This verifies the boundary split.
Direct expansion: |1-y conjugate(z)|^2-|y-z|^2=(1-|y|^2)(1-|z|^2)>=0. Probability normalization before Jensen and concavity on [0,1/10] are explicit on p27.
Integral from epsilon to exp(-1) of dq/[q log(1/q)] equals log log(1/epsilon), diverging at zero. E'<=C phi(E), E(0)=0 implies E=0; the uniform-in-profile time step permits iteration.
